{{Quote|We don't know what it was, sir, but it took out three platoons. We can't let the Colicoids get these things offplanet.|Republic Advanced Recon [[Commando/Legends|Commando]] Stec|<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
The '''Scorpenek annihilator droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] constructed by the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Scorpenek2-NEGTD.png|thumb|left|180px|An annihilator [[Droid/Legends|droid]]]]
In essence a much larger version of the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]]' [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], the Scorpenek annihilator [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was armed with two dual rapid-fire [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] cocked back in the menacing form of a rampant scorpion. It could target with either a crimson [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]], or with a composite [[radiation sensor]]. It also carried a combination [[Particle shield/Legends|particle]]-[[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]], similar to the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] produced by the annihilator's smaller cousin. Because of this extra shield, droidekas would position themselves inside the annihilator's shield for more protection. With fewer than one hundred annihilators on [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]], the Colicoids placed them around strategic or political resources. However, their [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was a large weakpoint and could be easily taken down by the slightest touch to the center of the eye.<ref name="NEGTD" />

During peacetime, annihilators could be reconfigured for scrapping ships or hauling cargo. Another popular modification was changing them to work in space as a mobile turret. This required adding [[Maneuvering jet/Legends|maneuvering thrusters]] and replacing one of the cannons with a [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]] for added firepower.<ref name="SGD" />

==History==
[[File:Scorpenek_droid_presentation.png|thumb|right|170px|[[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] displays a Scorpenek droid to Separatist leaders]]
In the later stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Republic Military/Legends|forces]] launched an [[Battle of Colla IV (Clone Wars)|attack on Colla IV]], where a single annihilator droid took out three of the four [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that had been advancing on the shielded factory. [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Stec]] was one of the survivors. Knowing more Republic forces would arrive, a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] task force was arranged by the Colicoids to ship the annihilators to the front lines of the war. Annihilator droids also participated at the [[Battle of Formos]] and the [[Battle of Palanhi (Clone Wars)|Battle of Palahni]], where they scored victories for the Confederacy.

A single annihilator could decimate a dozen [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] and make them nothing more than smoking husks. Not surprisingly, these droids struck fear into their enemies' hearts, and turned the tide in the battles at [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]] and [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] to score Separatist victories.

In the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Republic [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] had to send a large number of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] to take out a single annihilator, causing the Republic to further curse the massive droids. However, they did not have a huge influence on the war's outcome due to their huge price tags. They were so expensive in fact, there were believed to be less than a total of 100 annihilator droids in existence.

[[File:Annahilator-SGtD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Annihilators in action on a forested planet]]
Like all Confederacy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] at the end of the war, in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the annihilators were deactivated when the new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], sent the deactivation signal across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. After the droids were deactivated, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine<ref name="NEGTD" /> (the public persona of Sidious)<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> arranged for the remaining annihilators to be taken to the [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]]. Many were then taken from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Department of Military Research and were transported to be used on Palpatine's private citadel on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] world of [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="NEGTD" />
